# braintree

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Resources and tools for developers to integrate Braintree's global payments platform.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.braintreepayments.com/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/braintree/braintree_ruby
- 文档: https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs
- 更新日志: https://github.com/braintree/braintree_ruby/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/braintree/braintree_ruby/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/braintree
